purpose: Evaluate official dated Minnesota legislative conference-committee appointments as a zero-weight component of the single quick-evidence-v1 candidate.

source.system: Official Minnesota House and Senate Journals
source.authorityPolicy: dated chamber journal appointment is authoritative; Legislature conference-committee activity pages are diagnostic cross-checks only

asOfPolicy.match: exact bill ID plus membership ID
asOfPolicy.appointmentTiming: earliest official appointment date for that bill/member assignment
asOfPolicy.reason: journal appointment evidence is date-granular and does not prove ordering within a day

fit.model: single ridge logistic offset on serving Quick logit
selectionMetricOrder: validation chamber mean absolute yes-vote error

descriptivePolicy.emptySliceInterpretation: No 2025-2026 conferee-positive replay observations are available. The descriptive slice cannot support a stability claim and must not strengthen the diagnostic.

interpretation.positiveSignalMeaning: may justify continued prospective measurement inside quick-evidence-v1 only
